sections.text_helper: Section 70.3.6 "MDIOS APB frequency" in chapter 70 (Management data input/output (MDIOS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3607.
sections.section_content:
Whenever the firmware reads from MDIOS_DINRx or writes to MDIOS_DOUTRx, the
frequency of the APB bus must be at least 1.5times the MDC frequency. For example, if
MDC is at 20MHz, the APB must be at 30MHz or faster.
